ARM-7 safety

Rules

RULE: ARM-7 must not carry more than its payload rating. Overloading the arm trips the torque monitor and, more importantly, makes the brake holding test unreliable, so every new tool goes through the fixture register before it is mounted on the flange.

Hazards

HAZARD: ARM-7 at full speed can crush a hand when the guard is open. The crushing hazard exists at every joint and at the flange; the guard interlock is the only protection, so a demonstration never starts with a person inside the cell.
